templates.name: Introduction Email
templates.description: A warm first introduction explaining who you are and what you're building. Best for first contact with a potential partner, supporter, or ally.
templates.subject: Connecting on AI Literacy in Rural SC — {{senderName}} from {{organizationName}}

fields.label: Contact's First Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Kim

fields.label: Their Organization
fields.placeholder: e.g. SC Rural Innovation Network

fields.label: Your Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Joshua

fields.label: Your Title
fields.placeholder: e.g. Founder

fields.label: Why you're reaching out (1-2 sentences)
fields.placeholder: e.g. I've been thinking about the gap between how fast AI is changing the job market and how little access most rural SC communities have to even basic AI education. That gap is what pushed me to start this organization.

fields.label: What you're hoping for from this connection
fields.default: I'd love to explore whether there's an opportunity to collaborate — whether that's sharing resources, co-hosting a program, or simply learning from each other.
fields.placeholder: e.g. I'd love to explore whether there's a way to bring AI literacy programming into the communities you're already serving.

templates.name: Meeting Request
templates.description: A direct ask for a specific meeting. Use this when you've already had an introduction or when someone has expressed interest. More specific than the intro email — you're asking for a concrete time.
templates.subject: {{meetingLength}} Meeting Request — {{senderName}}, {{organizationName}}

fields.label: Contact's First Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Kim

fields.label: Your Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Joshua

fields.label: How you're connected (prior interaction)
fields.default: your time in connecting with us
fields.placeholder: e.g. your note back last week / connecting at the SCRIN event / our brief conversation at the incubator

fields.label: What the meeting is about (brief)
fields.default: our work in AI literacy and potential partnership opportunities
fields.placeholder: e.g. how we might bring AI education programming to communities you serve

fields.label: Proposed Dates and Times
fields.default:
I'm generally available:
- Tuesdays and Thursdays after 2pm ET
- Friday mornings
- Or anytime that works best for you
fields.placeholder: List 2-3 specific options, or describe your general availability

fields.label: Quick agenda (2-3 bullet points)
fields.default:
- Brief intro to SCAiL and our 3-phase vision
- Learn more about your current programs and the communities you serve
- Explore whether there's a natural fit for collaboration
fields.placeholder: What you want to talk about — keep it to 2-3 items

templates.name: Follow Up
templates.description: For when you've sent an initial message and haven't heard back. Gentle, brief, and respectful. People are busy — a thoughtful follow-up is expected, not pushy.
templates.subject: Re: {{originalSubject}}

fields.label: Contact's First Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Kim

fields.label: Their Organization
fields.placeholder: e.g. SC Rural Innovation Network

fields.label: Subject line of your original message
fields.placeholder: e.g. Connecting on AI Literacy in Rural SC

fields.label: What your original message was about
fields.default: our work in AI literacy and a potential conversation
fields.placeholder: e.g. exploring a partnership to bring AI education to rural SC communities

fields.label: How long ago you sent the first message
Anything new to add since your last message (optional)
fields.placeholder: e.g. Since I wrote, we've confirmed our first pilot location in Beaufort County — which makes the timing feel even more relevant.

templates.name: Partnership Proposal
templates.description: A more formal proposal for collaboration. Use this after you've had an initial conversation and there's mutual interest. Lays out specifically what you're proposing and what you're asking for.
templates.subject: Partnership Proposal — {{organizationName}} x {{contactOrganization}}

fields.label: Contact's First Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Kim

fields.label: Their Organization
fields.placeholder: e.g. SC Rural Innovation Network

fields.label: Why this partnership benefits both sides (2-4 bullet points)
fields.default:
- You reach communities that need what you offer, and we reach communities that need what we offer — together, we double our reach
- Your organization's trust and community presence combined with our AI education content creates something neither of us could build alone
- A documented partnership strengthens both our organizations' stories for grant applications
- We can co-design programming that reflects your deep knowledge of the communities we're both trying to serve
fields.placeholder: Be specific about what THEY get, not just what you need from them

fields.label: Exactly what you're proposing (be concrete)
fields.default:
- A formal Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) establishing us as organizational partners
- Co-hosting 2-3 AI literacy workshops at locations your organization already serves in Year 1
- Mutual promotion through our respective communications channels
- Exploring joint grant applications where our missions align
fields.placeholder: List your specific asks. Concrete is better than vague — it shows you've thought this through.
